verdict.rationale: Text was extracted from the public guidance pages at www.twc.texas.gov (register-tax, unemployment-tax, homepage). The same host returned ordinary HTTP 404 responses to probes rather than a bot-wall or CAPTCHA response, so the reading surface appears reachable by a keyless agent. The apps.twc.texas.gov connection reset affects the transactional application host, not the published guidance pages, so it does not count against this story. There is no explicit probe confirming the absence of a bot wall, JS-only shell or CAPTCHA, and no record of the user agent and HTTP 200 status on the guidance fetches, so coverage is not complete. Missing for 10: an explicit hands-on probe showing HTTP 200 server-rendered HTML for the guidance pages under an identified standard UA, confirmation that no CAPTCHA or JS challenge appears, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
